name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for car aesthetics. He spent countless hours sketching designs and meticulously detailing model cars. This passion led him to pursue vocational training in automotive painting and design, where he quickly excelled. After several years in the automotive industry, Jean-Pierre felt a pull towards the high-octane world of racing. He joined the Caterham Academy seeking to apply his skills in a more dynamic and demanding environment.

Jean-Pierre's approach to his role is characterized by a relentless pursuit of perfection and a deep understanding of color theory and paint application techniques. He views each car as a canvas, meticulously crafting finishes that are both visually striking and aerodynamically sound. His commitment to detail and calm demeanor makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

What sets Jean-Pierre apart is his ability to blend artistic flair with technical precision. He's not just a painter; he's a craftsman who understands the importance of aesthetics in motorsport. He brings an unmatched level of dedication to every project, whether it's a full livery design or a small touch-up, ensuring that every car reflects the Caterham Academy's commitment to excellence.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight wave
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height, with a lean build and intense, focused eyes.
